items.title: Fisheries of the Exclusive Economic Zone Off Alaska; Modify Groundfish Season Timing in the Bering Sea and Aleutian Islands and Gulf of Alaska Groundfish Fisheries

data.abstract: NMFS proposes two technical revisions to regulations for the opening and closing times of groundfish fisheries in the Bering Sea and Aleutian Islands (BSAI) and Gulf of Alaska (GOA) management areas. First, this proposed rule would authorize NMFS to determine the opening and closing times for the sablefish Individual Fishing Quota (IFQ) and Community Development Quota (CDQ) fishing season, taking into consideration the halibut IFQ/CDQ season set by the International Pacific Halibut Commission (IPHC). Second, this proposed rule would allow NMFS flexibility to change the time of day for closing a groundfish fishery. This proposed rule is necessary to minimize regulatory discards, reduce uncertainty for fishery participants, and enable fuller utilization and more precise limitation of allowable harvest. This action is intended to promote the goals and objectives of the Magnuson-Stevens Fishery Conservation and Management Act (Magnuson- Stevens Act), the Fishery Management Plan for the Groundfish of the BSAI Management Area (BSAI FMP) and the Fishery Management Plan for the Groundfish Fisheries of the GOA (GOA FMP), and other applicable laws.

items.title: Safety Zone; T/V DENISE FOSS (O.N. 1254223), Honolulu, HI

data.abstract: The Coast Guard is establishing a temporary safety zone for navigable waters within a 500-yard radius of the T/V DENISE FOSS (O.N. 1254223) and its tow, FOSS 3612 (O.N. 1255436). The moving safety zone is needed to protect personnel, vessels, and the marine environment from potential hazards associated with the transportation of two ship- to-shore cranes. Entry of vessels or persons into this zone is prohibited unless specifically authorized by the Captain of the Port, Sector Honolulu, or their designated representative.

items.title: Security Zones; Protection of Military Cargo, Captain of the Port Zone Puget Sound, WA

data.abstract: The Coast Guard will enforce security zones for the Protection of Military Cargo from October 30 through November 1, 2026, to provide for the security of life and vessels on navigable waterways during this event. Our regulation for Protection of Military Cargo within the Captain of the Port Zone Puget Sound, WA identifies the security zones for this event in the Blair Waterway and Sitcum Waterway, Commencement Bay, WA. During the enforcement periods, the operator of any vessel in the regulated area must comply with directions from the Captain of the Port or a designated representative.

items.title: Regulatory Considerations for Prescription Drug Use-Related Software; Guidance for Industry; Availability

data.abstract: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA or Agency) is announcing the availability of a final guidance for industry titled "Regulatory Considerations for Prescription Drug Use-Related Software." This final guidance describes FDA's application of its drug labeling authorities to certain software outputs that are disseminated by or on behalf of a drug sponsor for use with a prescription drug product or a prescription drug-led, drug-device combination product that is assigned to the Center for Drug Evaluation and Research or the Center for Biologics Evaluation and Research as the lead center. This guidance finalizes the draft guidance of the same title issued on September 19, 2023.

items.title: Formations of, Acquisitions by, and Mergers of Bank Holding Companies
Notification to Members/Shareholders

data.abstract: The NCUA Board (Board) solicits public comment on a proposal to streamline the methods a federally insured credit union (FICU) may use to provide its members with notice of share insurance coverage. The current regulation is overly prescriptive, mandating that a FICU make available hard copies of certain prescribed materials. While a FICU would still be required to provide notice to members, the proposed rule would defer to the FICU on the method used for such notification. Among other methods, a FICU may elect to provide members with a link to updated online resources that will be maintained on the NCUA website. The Board believes the proposed rule will provide greater flexibility, reduce compliance costs for both NCUA and FICUs, and ensure that members are provided with up-to-date information regarding share insurance coverage.

items.title: Privacy Act of 1974; System of Records

data.abstract: In accordance with the Privacy Act of 1974, as amended, the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB or Bureau) proposes to modify a current Privacy Act System of Records Notice (SORN) titled, "CFPB.001--Freedom of Information Act/Privacy Act System." This modification clarifies the purpose of the SORN, the categories of records and individuals, the legal authorities, the system manager, the system location address, and the records retention schedule, and introduces a new routine use to permit the disclosure of records to the National Archives and Records Administration (NARA) or other Federal agencies for records inspection purposes.

items.title: Nonconforming Investment Special Reserve

data.abstract: The NCUA Board (Board) is proposing to amend its regulations governing the requirements for federal share insurance. This action would remove the requirement for federally insured, state-chartered credit unions to establish a special reserve for certain investments that are beyond those authorized for federally chartered credit unions. The intended effect is to reduce unnecessary compliance and administrative burdens for state-chartered insured credit unions without diminishing the agency's ability to protect the National Credit Union Share Insurance Fund.

items.title: Conversion to State-Chartered Credit Union

data.abstract: The NCUA Board (Board) solicits public comment on a proposal to remove a regulatory provision regarding the process for maintaining federal share insurance following the conversion of a federal credit union (FCU) to a state charter. The provision is unnecessarily duplicative of a similar provision contained in NCUA's Chartering and Field of Membership Manual (Manual), and is outdated, having been superseded by amendments to the Manual.
